title: Claud Code Channels: Integrate Telegram & Discord #shorts
description: Join https://bit.ly/RoboNuggetsCommunity Unlock remote control for Claud Code sessions. The new Channels feature seamlessly integrates external tools like Telegram and Discord, enabling powerful inter-app communication and session management. #ClaudCode #DeveloperTools #Integrations #Tech
transcript: Next is channels, which is one of the biggest architectural shifts that Cloud Code has made this year so far. In channels, let's external tools push messages directly into your Cloud Code session. Now, among these options, the biggest integrations that people are talking about right now is the ability to connect Telegram, Discord, and even iMessage to Cloud Code. To give an example, you can see here in the terminal that it is currently listening for channel messages from my Telegram plugin. And here I'm on Telegram, and if I send a message here, what basically happens there is it routes that message back to the terminal and sends the message back to me. And so this is really useful if you want a simpler interface instead of the terminal interface or the VS Code extension for Cloud Code, or if you're away from your keyboard and want to operate your agents remotely, then this is something that you can do as well. What it also enables is replicate the same AI agent claw architecture that Open Claw has popularized.
